text:
Ana (Partnerships): Hey team — kicking off publisher provisioning + pricing tiers for the three-cloud listing. Need an ops checklist and owners so we don't lose time. TL;DR: AWS/GCP/Azure publisher IDs, billing SKUs, trial SKU config, legal pricing guardrails.

Vic (DevEx): Thanks Ana. Can you share which markets/regions we're prioritizing? that affects trial availability and pricing parity.

Ana (Partnerships): US, EU (Germany + UK), APAC: SG only for MVP. Want consistent visibility across clouds but flexible trial lengths per store.

Sam (Cloud): Copy. I'll start the pub account provisioning tasks. High-level plan:
1) AWS Marketplace: request Seller Central access, provide AMI/marketplace artifact, get Offer ID.
2) GCP Marketplace: register as publisher, upload billing descriptors, get Publisher ID.
3) Azure: Partner Center onboarding + offer manifest (plan/price tiers).
I'll create access doc and share creds via Vault.

Maria (Legal): Price guardrails — we need: list price floor, trial terms (30/14/7 days options per region), and a standard refund policy clause for marketplace contracts. Also we should avoid calling anything a "free tier" unless tethered to our billing plan.

Jordan (SRE): Heads up — images for AWS need hardened AMI with our startup scripts. Also we must include the telemetry opt-out blurb for EU. I'll add a checklist for required security artifacts (SBOM, penetration test window, certs).

Vic (DevEx): I'll own the packaging templates and sample marketplace docs for docs.redwood.com. Quick question: do we plan metered usage pricing or seat-based for initial listing?

Ana (Partnerships): Initial go-live: seat-based for enterprise plans, metered (tokens/hour) for dev/self-serve. We need 2 SKUs per cloud: "Starter (metered)" and "Pro (seat)" plus a trial plan. Pricing bands to be finalized with finance.

Maria (Legal): On trials: we should require explicit acceptance of marketplace terms + our EULA link. I'll draft the customer-facing trial T&Cs and a short privacy addendum for EU.

Sam (Cloud): Working on the technical checklist. Sample commands I'll need from engineering to validate images: 
```bash
# verify AMI packaging
aws ec2 describe-images --owner self --filters "Name=name,Values=redwood-*"
# basic smoke test
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .
```
I'll put these in the repo under infra/marketplace.

Jordan (SRE): For telemetry opt-out we can add env var READABLE: REDWOOD_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true in the AMI bootstrap. Also we'll need a maintenance window in the offer listing metadata.

Vic (DevEx): Can we standardize the pricing table format? I will create a CSV template: columns = [region, sku_code, unit_type, unit_price_usd, trial_days, billing_cycle]. Uploading to the partnership drive.

Ana (Partnerships): Action items:
- Sam: provision publisher accounts + starter checklist (due in 3 business days).
- Vic: packaging templates + pricing CSV (due EOD +2).
- Maria: draft trial terms + EU privacy addendum (due EOD +3).
- Jordan: security artifacts list + AMI hardening steps (due 5 business days).
- Me (Ana): coordinate finance and finalize price bands, schedule launch demo with partner ops.

pub-bot: Reminder: created ticket #PRJ-842 in Partnerships JIRA for marketplace onboarding. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PRJ-842

Sam (Cloud): ack — will ping once publisher IDs are minted.

Maria (Legal): ack — I'll post draft in this thread for quick review.

Vic (DevEx): ack, will scaffold docs and slot a short runbook for in-console purchase flow tests.

Ana (Partnerships): Great. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PT. If anything blocks earlier, drop updates here or DM. :thumbsup:
